newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand shares close higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand shares close higher in thin trade.

text.p: * New Zealand shares firm in desultory trading
* Telecom sheds early gains but ends higher
The New Zealand share market closed slightly higher at Monday's close in thin holiday-affected trade.

Telecom rose nine cents to NZ$7.22 in early trading on the back of strong performances by U.S. telecommunications issues on Friday. But by the close it had lost headway and finished five cents higher at $7.18.
Brierley Investments topped the turnover with 713,144 shares traded, closing steady at $1.30.
The NZSE40 capital index finished six points stronger at 2,356.43.
"A very quiet day. Nothing going on here at all, at all," ANZ Securities managing director Tim Preston said.
